judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token counts across tool rounds while handling missing usage metadata without producing NaN or erasing prior rounds. It satisfies all acceptance criteria in the issue, including a two-tool-round test (three provider calls), partial-reporting tests, type signature clarification (`turnUsage?: TurnUsageMetadata`), and updates to `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. Compared to the reference, the candidate unnecessarily extracts the helper into a new `turnUsage.ts` module and spreads tests across three new test files instead of adding to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. It also leaves new spec bullets under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, misses updating the `OrchestratorHooks` snippets in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and includes `.lore/dod.md` and `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs` changes.
